conversion: Photo All 2026-10-30: selected original base profiles, excluding push/pull/Alt/Early variants and negative/identity transforms; decoded native encoded-sRGB Hald samples at original 8/16-bit precision, interpreted row-major R-fastest G-next B-slowest, resampled with float32 trilinear interpolation to 33^3 encoded-sRGB SDR [B,G,R,RGB] NumPy arrays. This is a storage/resolution adaptation, not a physical film simulation. Original PNGs remain in the pinned source archive. No added grain or spatial effects.
